newsitem.title: USA: Brock says CFO Kohlsdorf resigns.
newsitem.headline: Brock says CFO Kohlsdorf resigns.

text.p: Brock International Inc said on Monday that Michael Kohlsdorf, president and chief financial officer of the company resigned to accept the position of president and chief executive officer of T/R Systems Inc, effective September 20, 1996.

"We are disappointed that we will be losing Mike's services. However, he indicated to me that this was an opportunity that he felt he could not turn down," Richard Brock, chairman of the company, said in a statement.
Richard Brock will assume Kohlsdorf's duties and responsibilities.
